game: CIN@PIT Week 11 2025, kickoff 2025-11-16 13:00 ET, PIT -5.5, total 48.5, outdoors, weather not in pack

script.base: PIT is a 5.5-point home favorite with implied totals 27.0-21.5 at a 48.5 outdoor total, so the book expects a PIT lead that is real but not a blowout. Rodgers leans on Jaylen Warren late to clock it (43 carries, 163 rush yards in weeks 8-10). Joe Burrow is out, Joe Flacco has been the CIN QB, and as the dog CIN throws: Ja'Marr Chase drew 50 targets for 363 yards in weeks 7-9, with Chase Brown mixing 34 carries/218 rush yards and 21 targets/99 rec yards.
script.flip1: PIT gets up big early. CIN's pass rush is down Trey Hendrickson and Shemar Stewart, and CIN allows 5.51 YPC, so Warren's carries spike and starters' late snaps get risky. CIN abandons the run, Brown's rush yards die, and Chase/Higgins stall if the game is out of reach.
script.flip2: CIN hangs around or leads. Flacco has been better vs the blitz (CIN EPA/db +0.13 vs blitz, -0.08 vs none; PIT blitzes 37%). PIT cannot salt it away, Warren's rush line stalls, and both passing games stay live so CIN WR yards and PIT WR2/TE work clear together.

injury_fallout: Pre-game nflverse report, not inactives (those lock ~90 min pre-kick and are not in the pack). CIN: Joe Burrow out (toe) locks Flacco; Samaje Perine out (ankle) vacates 17 carries/130 yards from weeks 7-9, which should funnel to Chase Brown first and only scraps to Tahj Brooks (2 games, 17 and 1 rush yards); Jermaine Burton out (illness) is a minor WR loss behind Chase/Higgins/Iosivas; Lucas Patrick questionable (calf) is an OL risk for pressure and rush efficiency; Trey Hendrickson out (hip) and Shemar Stewart out (knee) thin CIN's pass rush and help PIT's skill players stay on schedule. PIT: Darius Slay out (concussion) and Cory Trice Jr. questionable (hamstring) weaken the CB room for Chase and Tee Higgins; Cole Holcomb out (illness) is a LB loss that helps TE/RB receiving (Brown, Freiermuth, Jonnu Smith, Warren, Gainwell); Alex Highsmith out (pectoral) plus Isaac Seumalo questionable (pectoral) are PIT front-seven/OL issues, not a skill-position vacancy. No Doubtful tags.

matchup.shell: No MOFO/MOFC or man/zone chart in the pack. Location splits only: PIT allows YPA left 5.77, middle 9.1, right 7.88, and 29 passes of 20+ for 387 yards in 9 games. CIN allows YPA left 7.88, middle 8.3, right 7.61, and 34 passes of 20+ for 319 yards.
matchup.pressure: PIT blitzes 37%; CIN is better when blitzed (EPA/db +0.13 vs blitz, -0.08 with no blitz), which fits quick throws to Brown (21 targets, 10 air yards in 3 games) more than a sack-driven stall. CIN blitzes only 21%; PIT EPA/db is +0.05 vs blitz and -0.01 otherwise, and Hendrickson plus Stewart are out, so pressure on Rodgers should be lighter than CIN's season rate.
matchup.bleeds: PIT bleeds the middle (9.1 YPA) and explosives (29 of 20+), not the left side (5.77). Rush defense is ordinary-to-solid at 4.26 YPC and 27 runs of 10+. CIN bleeds the run at 5.51 YPC and 36 runs of 10+, and is soft to explosives on all thirds of the field.
matchup.overlap: CIN's top option is Chase (50 targets, 340 air yards in weeks 7-9) into a PIT secondary missing Slay, with the middle at 9.1 YPA. Higgins (21 targets, 294 air yards, 261 yards) is the second shot at that same hole. Brown's 21 short targets overlap the blitz-checkdown and the Holcomb absence more than PIT's 4.26 YPC run defense.

pre_mortem: It is Monday and both lost because PIT led by three scores at half, Hendrickson's absence let Rodgers stay ahead of the chains, and CIN's offense became a one-note Chase chase that still only managed a quiet Flacco day. Brown repeated the 42-plus-7 game once Patrick's calf limited the interior and the staff gave Brooks the leftover carries, finishing under 65.5. Higgins repeated 44 or worse because the missing forecast was 15-mph wind, the air yards never showed up, and whoever replaced Slay sat on him while Chase drew the targets. That counter is real on the blowout flip and the unknown weather, which is why Higgins is a lean, but it is not stronger than Brown's three-game 106 combined against 65.5 with Perine now out, so Brown stays.
slip_story: One story only: competitive PIT lead, CIN dog has to throw with Flacco. Stack is Brown rushrecyds over (checkdowns plus leftover carries after Perine) with Higgins recyds over (Slay out, middle-field bleed). Do not add a game under, a Warren rush over, or a Gainwell rush under to this slip; those need PIT to clock it. Chase over 94.5 is the same story but the number is his median and was left off. No TDs, no second market on either player.
